Decoded correctness is an external readout measurement, not evidence that the model naturally uses that information or that it causes an answer. Weighting seeds, lexical twins, numeric draws and query siblings are not independent replications. Other slots can be answer ancestors. Query is future text at sites3/7, so slot/recency differences are not query effects. Intervals condition on saved fits, omit refitting and multiplicity correction.
